notes.title: Patch Notes [Version 1.4]
notes.content:
[b]Shop & Inventory: [/b]Items can be inspected via right-click to display relevant details, such as skills associated with a weapon.

[b]Player UI Update:[/b] Attack cost is now indicated, and skills can only be activated if the maximum stamina exceeds the attack cost. A warning will appear if stamina is insufficient.

[b]Starting Weapon:[/b] Now randomized for more variety.

[b]
Bug Fixes:[/b]

    Repair now correctly resets player armor.

    Buckler skill image is displayed properly again.

    Bug monsters' flying animation now functions as intended.

notes.title: Patch Notes [Version 1.3]
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Thanks for all your feedback—it really helps shape the game!

This update reworks the skill system to make classes more balanced and engaging. Special thanks to Zac for pointing out the confusion with skill icons!
Skill Changes & Improvements:

    Added One-Handed Skill – Includes Counter-Attack for better dueling potential.

    Lionheart Skill – Now improves survivability!

    Reduced Magic Weapon AoE but added Magic Diffusion to increase it as a skill upgrade.

    New Shieldwall Skill – Increases shield durability for better defense.

    New Specializations for Dual-Wield & Two-Handed Weapons:

        Whirlwind – A great defensive ability for dual-wielders to improve their survivability

        Stormtrooper – A powerful upgrade for two-handed weapon users.

    Removed Dexterity, Survivalist, Unstoppable to refine skill progression.


    Reworked Crossbow & Skill Tree Abilities – Crossbows now have unique strengths and more tactical depth.


    Added a toggle button for windowed mode in the options window!


    Magic Staffs now display unique support icons based on their element!


⚠ Important: Due to these changes, old saves are no longer compatible!!!

Thanks for playing and helping improve the game! Keep the feedback coming! 🚀

notes.title: Patch Notes [Version 1.2]
notes.content:
Reworked the scoreboard – Now more player-friendly! Penalties have been adjusted so that progress is always reflected in your score.

    Commands can now be given during pauses – This should make controlling your units smoother in battle.

    Fixed aura and armor reset bug – Auras and player armor now properly reset when restarting the game.

notes.title: Patch Notes [Version 1.1]
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Thanks for your feedback. Here’s a new update with some fixes and improvements:

    Fixed 2-handed weapon AoE attack – It should now properly hit all enemies in range.

    Adjusted dragon's AoE hitbox – The damage area should now better match the visual indicator.

    Fixed music volume issues – Background music should now stay consistent when changing scenes.

    Investigating magic damage inconsistencies and targeting issues – I haven’t been able to reproduce these yet, but I’m looking into them. If you notice any patterns or specific situations where they happen, please let me know!

Thanks for playing and helping improve the game!
